title: rumohra cavaleriei
intro: Rumohra cavaleriei, commonly known as the Chinese Leopards' Bane or Leopard's Bane, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra cavaleriei include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidant, and bronchodilator, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
